Future<List<R>> mapPool<T, R>(List<T> items, int limit, Future<R> Function(T item) read) async {
 final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
 var next = 0;
 await Future.wait(List.generate(limit, (_) async {
  while (next < items.length) {
   final index = next++;
   results[index] = await read(items[index]);
  }
 }));
 return results.cast<R>();
}
Future<void> escape(items, int width) async {
 var next = 0;
 await Future.wait(List.generate(width, (_) async {
  while (next < items.length) {
   final index = next++;
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
   results[index] = await read(items[index]);
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
   await audit(index);
  }
 }));
}
